title: Price-Drop Rebate in Northgate Protect Standard Plan Cancellation Refunds
content:
A price-drop rebate is added to the Northgate Protect Standard plan cancellation refund from the covered order line, as the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records show its price adjustments and its line amount (the net price paid for the line):

- **Line carries Northgate price-drop adjustments:** the drop rebate share, the whole (a share of 1), of the price kept times those adjustments divided by the line's amount;
- **Line carries only competitor price-match adjustments:** the match rebate share, one half (0.5), of the price kept times those adjustments divided by the line's amount;
- **Otherwise:** nothing.

"Those adjustments" means the total amount refunded by the adjustments of that kind booked against the covered order line. The price kept is the plan's one-time charges less any refunds already booked on it.

| Adjustments booked against the covered order line | Rebate added |
|---|---|
| Northgate price-drop adjustment | Price kept multiplied by the adjustments, divided by the line's amount |
| Competitor price-match adjustment only | One half of the price kept multiplied by the adjustments, divided by the line's amount |
| None | Nothing |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- Price kept $59.00; line amount $480.00; a Northgate price drop refunded $48.00: $59.00 multiplied by 48 and divided by 480 is $5.90.
- Price kept $59.00; line amount $480.00; a competitor match refunded $48.00: one half of $5.90, $2.95.
